newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgacom to cut call rates from March 1998.
newsitem.headline: Belgacom to cut call rates from March 1998.

text.p: Belgian state-controlled telecoms group Belgacom said on Wednesday it would cut call rates from March 1998 by 15 percent on average.
"In March 1998 Belgacom will reduce its national tariffs. This will result in a reduction of call costs by about 15 percent," the company said in a statement.
As a first step to pricing per second Belgacom would start to simplify its pricing structure on September 1.

From September the number of different tariffs will be reduced to four from the current nine. From March 1998 Belgacom will abandon the principle of a price per pulse (6.05 Belgian francs per variable time unit) and switch to pricing per second.
Under the new system 85 percent of calls would be cheaper and 15 percent more expensive.
